title: Cool Blackcurrant Lemonade 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid by Seriously Nice
description: Seriously Nice Cool Blackcurrant Lemonade 100ml shortfill gives you a zing of icy citrusy lemon flavour chased by the rich sweet taste of blackcurrant. Mixed to a 70/30 VG/PG ratio, Seriously Nice is supplied in a 100ml bottle, filled with 100ml nicotine free e-liquid.
